verified: Explicit Hub model profile requires exact backend/model, environment digest and automatic execution authorization; missing or denied profiles cannot reserve runs
A separate Hub RUN is persisted in reserved state over admitted exact model request and verified Tool output sources before any model execution
Actual tool-role messages must exactly equal the deterministic untrusted rendering of verified Hub results; absent, omitted or replaced results are denied
Assignment, lease, chat revision, current repository source scope, model profile and environment bindings are rechecked before projection and result acceptance
Result acceptance verifies the exact reserved projection and immutable input source, rechecks current Tool input admission, admits exact output bytes and completes only the original run
OpenAI-compatible and Ollama result protocols, usage/output budgets and bounded tool proposals are checked; invalid results fail the reserved run
Repeated nonces and duplicate completion cannot create another accepted execution; unrelated source revisions do not revoke current chat
remaining: Dedicated authenticated model-run route, opt-in bootstrap and owned cooperative Worker transport
Invoke reservation before every actual model provider request and finish exact result before accepting it; wire assigned dialog/toolbox
Combined normal Task/executor/browser/model-tool acceptance, Task cancellation cleanup of outstanding reserved model runs, and production provider/GPU/lipsync/rollout
architecture_review: Separate profile policy, exact tool-input admission, immutable content persistence, Registry issuance and model run lifecycle protect SRP/DIP. Shared deterministic tool framing and result validation avoid Hub imports in the Worker. The Hub profile environment digest is an operator-declared execution binding, not proof of a deployed image. Existing configuration/service locator coupling is preserved; inject policy and execution ports. The finish controller still mixes immutable intent resolution with lifecycle checks; a focused intent reader would reduce this preserved SRP readability debt. No Worker orchestration was introduced.
scope_boundaries: Actual SQL Registry/content stores and current Task/source policy execute with explicit synthetic model-result and Task/MCP fixtures
No actual model provider request or installed runtime wiring is exercised by this service gate
A Task revoked before finish binding may leave its model run reserved; it cannot accept output, and Hub lifecycle cancellation cleanup remains required
Local/test evidence does not satisfy production release gates; no deployment or model-answer grounding claim
